scope: Close preview and details with a persistent cross, the toolbar toggle, P, or Esc; fold the active Author search fields and cards without cancelling work or clearing results, and retain the fold choice.

excluded: pop-bridge.test.mjs: Unix executable fixtures on Windows

checks.name: clicking Author search collapses its fields and cards
collapsing authors gives their space to the results
folding retains the author input, selection and active mode
a second click restores the author fields and cards
folding an active search does not abort it
the saved collapsed state restores on a new page
Preview opens the PDF pane with an accessible close cross
the toolbar Preview action changes to Close preview
the cross stays visible after scrolling details
the cross collapses the whole detail pane and releases result space
closing retains selection and puts focus back in the list
the Close preview control also collapses details
P can reopen preview from the focused list
P can close the complete preview pane
Escape closes the complete preview pane
choosing another row reopens its normal details
Preview can reopen a detail pane disabled from View
saved detail height is retained
the close cross remains within the detail pane at 1600
the close cross remains within the detail pane at 1000
the close cross remains within the detail pane at 760
the close cross remains within the detail pane at 640
the close cross remains usable at the minimum saved detail height
the compact toolbar action keeps its accessible close label
the close cross has the correct label in zh
the localized close cross collapses details in zh
the close cross has the correct label in ko
the localized close cross collapses details in ko
no script errors or network requests occurred

installed.interaction_verification: Unit tests with the production renderer and handlers; headless Chrome with the actual search markup, stylesheet, layout and select functions. Native Zotero clicks were not tested.

limits: Interaction and geometry checks use offline fixtures. Native Zotero clicks were not tested.
The browser fixture uses fictional papers and the actual markup, styles, pane lifecycle, keyboard handler, and detail renderer. PDF and metadata services are mocked.
Production search controllers, add behavior, and sidebar width persistence are covered by unit fixtures.
The Windows offline test run excludes pop-bridge.test.mjs because its Unix executable fixtures are incompatible.
Style Custom remains at 0.59.60. Its code and package were not changed.
